# Owner-supplied personal photograph

`luxembourg-last-stop.jpg` is the photograph supplied by Ave on 30 October 2026 for the scrapbook's main photograph. Its original 960×1280 JPEG bytes are preserved without cropping or visual alteration. The accompanying English memory adapts only the owner's supplied account. The exact sightseeing date and bridge name are not inferred. It is personal content, not a stock or generated couple photograph.
